title: Effect of Documented Workshop Care on the Evidence a Fault Report Carries
content:
Where a vehicle offered as a Keyturn Vehicle Listing has been through a workshop under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan, the work is already documented, and the evidence figure the fault record is opened with is taken at a share of what the standard evidence figure and its additions give. What is counted is the completed visits standing on that vehicle's Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan in the rolling twelve months counted back from the handling date.

1. A vehicle with two or more completed Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan visits in that window has the figure taken at two thirds of what the standard evidence figure and its additions give, rounded up to a whole photograph.

2. A vehicle with exactly one completed care plan visit in that window has it taken at three quarters of that figure, rounded up to a whole photograph.

3. A vehicle with no completed care plan visit in that window has the figure taken as the standard evidence figure and its additions give it.

### Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a figure of 10 photographs before this rule is read.

- With 2 completed care plan visits in the window: two thirds of 10 is 6.67 photographs, which rounds up to 7.
- With 1 completed care plan visit in the window: three quarters of 10 is 7.5 photographs, which rounds up to 8.
- With no completed care plan visit in the window: the figure stands at 10.

The rounding is always upward to a whole photograph, so a share that lands exactly on a whole number is left where it is: two thirds of 9 is 6 photographs exactly, and 6 is the figure taken.
